Hard directional morning sunlight streams through the open glass doors creating clean geometric shadows and warm soft fills with gentle highlights across hands and product surfaces, high-key natural and immediate. Intimate close-up framing slightly above eye level with shallow depth of field locking focus on hands and the held product, mirror reflection and billowing curtains softly blurred behind, 50mm lens natural handheld micro-energy, crisp 16:9 composition emphasizing tactile ritual and serene coastal stillness.
